project.title: AWS Cloud Migration (In-house custom SaaS platform)
project.role: DevOps, Operations and Cloud Architect; Project Management

parentsummary.deliverables: Architected and delivered the migration of 40+ production workloads from VMware on-premises infrastructure to AWS, right-sizing compute and storage to cloud-native microservice patterns, designing the SaaS application access control architecture, and achieving ISO:27001, NIST, and HIPAA compliance across the migrated platform.
parentsummary.outcomes: Migrated 40+ production workloads to AWS achieving a 35% cost reduction through cloud optimization and delivering improved platform resilience, with full compliance alignment to ISO:27001, NIST, and HIPAA.

challenge.summary: Architected and managed the migration and implementation of on-premise systems into the AWS cloud platform. This involved right-sizing systems, provisioning micro-service based architecture and leveraging cloud-based security principles.

deliverables: Project Management using Agile methodologies, and hybrid reporting
Needs analysis, define requirements, and plan migration route
Market compliance under HIPAA & NIST guidelines
Convened cross-functional working groups spanning development, QA, professional services, IT support, sales, and customer representatives
Implementation of IT Security and Cyber Protection Controls. Map to ISO:27001, NIST, and HIPAA
Designed the SaaS application access control architecture
Review and realign infrastructure with cloud offerings
Staged migratory testing of services with inline remediation
Internal feedback to development and operations for change coordination
Provide documentation, knowledge transfer, and cross-training

outcomes: ✅ Successfully migrated 40+ production workloads from VMware to AWS, achieving 35% cost reduction through cloud optimization and improved platform resilience
